# Frontend State Machine — Scene 路由狀態機

> 來源：FRONTEND.md §4.2 Navigation Map（已有 stateDiagram-v2，本圖在其基礎上補齊 entry/exit/guard）。
> 描述使用者從進入 ERP 到離開 P03 揭示頁的完整路由狀態流轉。

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> ERPLogin : 進入 ERP [unauthenticated] / loadLoginPage()

    ERPLogin --> P01_Index : authenticate(credentials) [valid] / setSessionCookie()
    P01_Index --> ERPLogin : sessionExpired() [cookieExpired] / clearAlpineState()

    state P01_Index {
        entry: fetchTokens(userId, status, page), renderListing()
        exit: cleanupAlpineComponents()
    }
    state P01_Index : 路由 /ApiTokens；嵌入 P02 Modal、P04 Dialog

    P01_Index --> P02_CreateModal : openCreateModal() [tokenCount lt 50] / focusInput()
    P02_CreateModal --> P01_Index : cancelOrEsc() [always] / resetForm()
    P02_CreateModal --> P02_CreateModal : submitInvalid() [validationError] / showInlineError()
    P02_CreateModal --> P03_Created : submitSuccess(rawToken) [201] / writeTempData()

    state P02_CreateModal {
        entry: validate(description), enableSubmit()
        exit: clearInput()
    }
    state P02_CreateModal : 路由 /ApiTokens (Alpine modal)；狀態 description / isSubmitting / error

    P03_Created --> P01_Index : closeAfterConfirm() [confirmCheckbox checked] / dispatchToast()
    P03_Created --> P05_N8nGuide : viewN8nGuide() [always] / navigate()
    P03_Created --> P01_Index : refreshOrDirectAccess() [tempDataConsumed] / autoRedirect()

    state P03_Created {
        entry: readTempData(rawToken), setCacheControl(no-store)
        exit: tempDataConsumed = true
    }
    state P03_Created : 路由 /ApiTokens/Created；一次性揭示，重新整理即清空

    P01_Index --> P04_RevokeDialog : clickRevoke(tokenId) [token.userId == currentUser OR isITAdmin] / openDialog()
    P04_RevokeDialog --> P01_Index : cancel() [always] / closeDialog()
    P04_RevokeDialog --> P01_Index : confirmRevokeSuccess() [200] / showSuccessToast()
    P04_RevokeDialog --> P04_RevokeDialog : revokeError() [5xx] / showRetryButton()

    state P04_RevokeDialog {
        entry: setIsLoading(false), setTokenId(id)
        exit: clearDialogState()
    }
    state P04_RevokeDialog : 路由 /ApiTokens (Alpine dialog)

    P01_Index --> P05_N8nGuide : clickEmptyStateOrSidebar() [always] / navigate()
    P05_N8nGuide --> P01_Index : clickCreateToken() [always] / navigate()
    P05_N8nGuide --> P06_Demo : clickTryDemo() [always] / navigate()

    state P05_N8nGuide {
        entry: lazyLoadScreenshots()
        exit: noop
    }
    state P05_N8nGuide : 路由 /ApiTokens/N8nGuide

    P06_Demo --> P01_Index : back() [always] / navigate()
    state P06_Demo {
        entry: initPocTesterComponent()
        exit: clearBearerTokenMemory()
    }
    state P06_Demo : 路由 /Demo；Bearer Token 僅存 memory

    P01_Index --> P07_AuditLog : clickAuditLogSidebar() [isSuperuser] / navigate()
    P07_AuditLog --> P09_Forbidden : nonAdminAccess() [isSuperuser == false] / show403()
    P07_AuditLog --> P01_Index : back() [always] / navigate()
    P07_AuditLog --> ERPLogin : sessionExpired() [cookieExpired] / clearAlpineState()
    P09_Forbidden --> P01_Index : clickReturnHome() [always] / navigate()

    state P07_AuditLog {
        entry: fetchAuditEntries(filters, page), renderTable()
        exit: cleanupFilterAlpine()
    }
    state P07_AuditLog : 路由 /ApiTokens/AuditLog；Guard ITAdminPolicy

    P01_Index --> [*] : userLogout() [always] / signOutAsync()

    note right of P03_Created
      P03 是「一次性揭示頁」：
      - TempData 寫入後僅讀一次
      - Cache-Control: no-store
      - 重新整理 → TempData 已清空 → 自動 redirect 回 P01
    end note

    note right of P07_AuditLog
      RBAC Guard：
      - ITAdminPolicyHandler 檢查 isSuperuser=true
      - 失敗 → P09_Forbidden（403）
      - Session 過期 → ERPLogin
    end note

    note right of P02_CreateModal
      錯誤狀態：
      - 422 描述空 / 過長 → inline error + shake
      - 429 達 50 上限 → 顯示「請先撤銷舊 Token」
      - 401 → AuthGuard redirect
    end note
```

## 狀態說明

| 狀態 | 路由 | Auth Guard | TTL / 邊界條件 |
|------|------|-----------|----------------|
| `ERPLogin` | `/Login` | 無 | ERP 主應用 |
| `P01_Index` | `/ApiTokens` | Cookie | Session 有效 |
| `P02_CreateModal` | `/ApiTokens (modal)` | Cookie + CSRF | 表單未提交時持久 |
| `P03_Created` | `/ApiTokens/Created` | Cookie + TempData | TempData 一次性，重新整理即失效 |
| `P04_RevokeDialog` | `/ApiTokens (dialog)` | Cookie + CSRF | 對話框關閉即失效 |
| `P05_N8nGuide` | `/ApiTokens/N8nGuide` | Cookie | 無 |
| `P06_Demo` | `/Demo` | Cookie（頁面 Auth）+ Bearer（API call）| Bearer 僅 memory |
| `P07_AuditLog` | `/ApiTokens/AuditLog` | Cookie + ITAdminPolicy | 90 天日誌 |
| `P09_Forbidden` | `/Forbidden` | 無 | 拒絕後返回首頁 |

## Guard 條件

| Transition | Guard |
|-----------|-------|
| P01 → P02 | `tokenCount < 50`（CONSTANTS `Active Tokens 上限`）|
| P01 → P04 | `token.userId == currentUser OR isITAdmin`（PRD US-AUTH-003）|
| P01 → P07 | `isSuperuser == true` |
| 任何 → ERPLogin | `cookieExpired`（401 攔截觸發）|
| P02 → P03 | API 回 201 Created |
